# Strata

> A notebook built for coding agents: every result cached, versioned, and visible to the human watching

## Get started

- [Strata](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/index.md): Strata is a notebook your coding agent can drive, and everything it computes stays.
- [Install](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/getting-started/installation/index.md): Install Strata, and the commands it gives you.
- [Your first notebook](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/getting-started/notebook/index.md): Strata Notebook is an interactive notebook with content-addressed caching, automatic dependency tracking, and cascade execution.
- [Use a coding agent](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/agent/index.md): `strata agent <notebook-dir>` is a one-command on-ramp: it stands up everything a coding agent (Claude Code) needs to drive a live Strata notebook, and attache…
- [Terminal viewer](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/tui/index.md): `strata-notebook-tui` is a read-only terminal spectator for a live notebook session.
- [Coming from Jupyter](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/import/index.md): `strata import` converts a Jupyter `.ipynb` file into a Strata notebook directory, or unpacks a snapshot back into one.

## Examples

- [Gallery](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/examples/index.md): Every notebook under `examples/` in the repo demonstrates a specific Strata capability.
- [Tutorial: what the cache saves](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/caching/index.md): A two-minute tour of caching.
- [The Keeling curve, with a receipt](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/keeling_curve/index.md): Atmospheric CO₂ at Mauna Loa since 1958, from NOAA's monthly record: the curve, the yearly cycle split out, the growth rate by decade, and a published figure w…
- [Classify iris flowers, from raw data to a confusion matrix](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/iris_classification/index.md): Classic scikit-learn tutorial, rewritten as a Strata notebook.
- [Filter, group, merge and pivot a sales table](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/pandas_basics/index.md): A guided tour of the pandas operations you reach for every day, split into one cell per concept.
- [Predict Titanic survival with three classifiers](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/titanic_ml/index.md): A canonical "first Kaggle notebook" rewritten for Strata.
- [Page through 2,000 transactions](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/data_viewer/index.md): A two-cell notebook that produces DataFrames larger than the 20-row inline preview, so the notebook's interactive data viewer pages through the full frame.
- [Train a model once, re-run only its evaluation](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/agent_demo/index.md): This is the notebook from the `strata agent` demo: a coding agent (Claude Code) builds it live while you watch in the terminal UI.
- [Switch between three classifiers without retraining](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/model_variants/index.md): The same iris pipeline as `iris_classification`, but with three alternative training cells grouped as variants of the same DAG slot.
- [Run every model variant and compare their accuracy](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/model_variants_sweep/index.md): A minimal example of variant sweep mode: run every variant of a group and compare them all in one downstream cell.
- [Triage customer reviews into validated JSON with an LLM](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/review_triage/index.md): Demonstrates `# @output_schema` on a prompt cell.
- [Classify arXiv papers across three workers](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/arxiv_classifier/index.md): A full ML workflow that exercises every differentiated feature of Strata Notebook at once:
- [Paper-trade on overnight news sentiment](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/news_alpha_trader/index.md): An end-to-end LLM-driven trading notebook.
- [Report top orders and revenue from SQL and Python](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/sql_orders_report/index.md): A small five-cell notebook that demonstrates Strata's SQL cell support against a local SQLite warehouse.
- [Hill-climb Himmelblau's function, one cached step at a time](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/loop_hill_climb/index.md): Four-code-cell notebook (plus a markdown cell) that exercises every moving part of Strata's loop cell feature: the `@loop` / `@loop_until` annotations, per-ite…
- [Drive a plot with a slider, a number and a dropdown](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/widget_playground/index.md): A three-cell notebook: a widget cell (a control panel) feeding two Python cells, one that renders a DataFrame and one that draws a chart.
- [Share functions between cells](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/library_cells/index.md): Walks through cross-cell library code in Strata Notebook: pure module cells, mixed runtime+library cells, PEP 563 type annotations, and the limitations slicing…
- [Read a NOAA weather file from a public S3 bucket](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/s3_mount/index.md): Demonstrates Strata's mount feature: a notebook cell can read a remote filesystem path as if it were local, with no custom code inside the cell.
- [Process weather files one by one into an Iceberg table](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/each_pipeline/index.md): A cell that runs once per file, caches each file separately, and keeps an Iceberg table in step with the results.
- [Write reports in Markdown, by hand or from data](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/markdown_showcase/index.md): Every way Strata renders Markdown, in one notebook: headings, emphasis, lists, tables, code blocks, blockquotes, links, and the sanitizer that keeps script in…
- [Model car mileage in R, with plots inline](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/r_mtcars_analysis/index.md): A pure-R notebook: every cell is R.
- [Fit one regression in R and in scikit-learn](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/examples/r_lm_vs_sklearn/index.md): Fit the same housing-price model with R's `lm()` and Python's `scikit-learn`.

## Guides

- [Cell kinds](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/cells/index.md): Strata Notebook has six cell kinds, plus loop cells (a Python cell with a `# @loop` annotation):
- [Python cells](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/cells/python/index.md): The default.
- [SQL cells](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/cells/sql/index.md): A SQL cell sends a query to a connected database via ADBC (DuckDB through its own driver) and stores the result as an Arrow Table artifact.
- [R cells](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/cells/r/index.md): R is a first-class notebook language alongside Python.
- [Prompt cells](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/cells/prompt/index.md): A prompt cell is a text template that gets rendered with upstream variable values, sent to an AI model, and the response stored as an artifact.
- [Widget cells](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/cells/widget/index.md): A widget cell is a declarative control panel - one control per line - that feeds values into the DAG.
- [Loops and variants](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/cells/loops-and-variants/index.md): A loop cell is a regular Python cell with a `# @loop` annotation.
- [Cell unit tests](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/testing/index.md): Every Python cell can carry its own `pytest` tests - written right next to the cell, run against the cell's real outputs, with per-test pass/fail surfaced inli…
- [Mounts](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/data/mounts/index.md): Attach a filesystem mount to the cell.
- [Lake and Iceberg](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/lake-aware-cells/index.md): A lake-aware cell is a notebook cell that takes an Iceberg table as a versioned input via the `@table` annotation.
- [Fetch and datasets](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/data/fetch-and-datasets/index.md): Declare a URL the cell reads.
- [Write back](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/data/write-back/index.md): Write one of the cell's variables into an Iceberg table when the run succeeds: a cleaning cell that replaces a table, an ingest cell that appends each day's da…
- [Workers](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/workers/index.md): Strata Notebook can dispatch individual cells to remote machines via the executor protocol.
- [Worker pool](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/worker-pool/index.md): Worker pool for dispatching Strata jobs to ephemeral machines.
- [Run cells over SSH](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/compute/ssh/index.md): If you have a box you reach over SSH (a GPU machine, a bigger instance, one closer to the data), Strata can turn it into a worker for you in one step, without…
- [Environment](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/environment/index.md): Each notebook has its own isolated Python environment managed by uv.
- [Secrets](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/secrets/index.md): Strata can pull environment variables from an external secret manager so API keys, database URLs, and other sensitive config don't have to be re-entered every…
- [App view](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/share/app-view/index.md): Click App in the notebook header (or visit `/#/app/<sessionId>`) to open the notebook as a read-only interactive app: only widget control panels, markdown, and…
- [Publish an artifact](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/publishing/index.md): A figure in a paper can carry a URL.
- [Export and import](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/export/index.md): `strata export` renders a notebook directory to a single self-contained file, markdown or HTML, for sharing or archiving.
- [Team store](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/guides/share/team-store/index.md): By default service mode is read-only to clients, computation goes through server-side transforms.
- [Registry dashboard](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/registry-dashboard/index.md): The registry dashboard is the UI for promoting models and approving changes right inside the notebook - so promotion doesn't have to be code.
- [MCP server](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/mcp/index.md): Strata Notebook can expose a running notebook session to an external coding agent (Claude Code, and any other Model Context Protocol client) over an HTTP endpo…
- [CLI authoring](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/agent-authoring/index.md): A Strata notebook is a plain-text directory - TOML config plus one source file per cell.
- [Agent scratchpad](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/scratchpad/index.md): A coding agent working on *something else* (debugging your service, exploring a dataset, checking what a function returns) keeps running a bit of throwaway Pyt…
- [Library quickstart](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/getting-started/core/index.md): Strata Core is the programmatic materialization and artifact layer.
- [Artifacts and registry](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/core/registry/index.md): Every materialized result in Strata is an immutable, versioned artifact with content-addressed provenance.

## Concepts

- [How caching works](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/concepts/caching/index.md): *Edit one cell in `strata tutorial`: only the cells that read it run again, and the cell above keeps what it saved.
- [The DAG and staleness](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/concepts/dag-and-staleness/index.md): Each cell's source code is analyzed by cellgraph (Python's AST and `symtable` for Python cells, its own analyzers for R and SQL) to extract:
- [Artifacts and lineage](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/concepts/artifacts-and-lineage/index.md): Strata Notebook is a content-addressed compute graph over Python.
- [File format and git](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/concepts/file-format-and-git/index.md): Each notebook is a directory on disk:
- [How Strata compares](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/comparison/index.md): Strata is closest in spirit to the new generation of reactive notebooks (marimo, Pluto.jl) - it shares the "your DAG comes from your variable references" idea.
- [Features](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/concepts/features/index.md): The interactive notebook surface: Python, R, SQL, prompt, widget and loop cells, each producing artifacts that flow through an auto-built DAG.

## Reference

- [Annotations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/annotations/index.md): R cells take a subset of these: see R annotations.
- [Python annotations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/annotations/python/index.md): These apply to Python cells, and most to other compute cells too.
- [SQL annotations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/annotations/sql/index.md): A cell with `language = "sql"` runs a query through a declared connection.
- [R annotations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/annotations/r/index.md): The same annotation parser handles both Python and R cells (`#`-prefixed comments at the top of the source).
- [Prompt annotations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/annotations/prompt/index.md): Prompt cells (language `prompt`) accept an additional set of annotations that configure the AI call.
- [Loop and variant annotations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/annotations/loops-and-variants/index.md): A Python cell carrying `@loop` is executed iteratively.
- [Widget and app view annotations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/annotations/widget/index.md): On a widget cell, `# @live` makes a control change auto-run the cheap downstream cells instead of only marking them stale.
- [CLI](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/cli/index.md): `strata run` executes every cell in a notebook directory without starting the server or opening the UI.
- [notebook.toml](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/notebook-toml/index.md): `notebook.toml` is the committed configuration for a notebook.
- [Configuration](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/configuration/index.md): Strata is configured via environment variables (prefixed with `STRATA_`) or a `[tool.strata]` section in `pyproject.toml`.
- [REST API](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/rest-api/index.md): This page documents the notebook REST surface, mounted under `/v1/notebooks`, plus the core routes a client meets most: materialize, streams, health and metric…
- [WebSocket protocol](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/websocket/index.md): The notebook UI communicates with the backend via a WebSocket connection for real-time updates.
- [Notebook client protocol](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/notebook-protocol/index.md): A single reference for writing a non-Vue client (TUI, scripting, third-party integration) against the notebook backend.
- [Executor protocol](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/executor-protocol/index.md): The executor protocol is the HTTP contract between Strata's notebook orchestrator and remote workers.
- [Worker relay protocol](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/reference/worker-connect/index.md): `strata-worker --connect <url>` runs a worker that binds no port.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/notebook/keyboard/index.md): Press ? anywhere in the notebook (outside a code editor or text field) to show the shortcuts modal.

## Deploy

- [Deployment modes](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/modes/index.md): Strata's `deployment_mode` is `personal` or `service`.
- [Service mode](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/service-mode/index.md): Service mode is what you run when more than one person uses Strata through a network.
- [Docker](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/docker/index.md): Run Strata in Docker with Compose.
- [Fly.io](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/fly/index.md): This page deploys Strata on Fly.io as a single-tenant, personal-mode server, from the template `fly.example.toml` at the repository root.
- [GitHub Codespaces](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/codespaces/index.md): Click "Open in Codespaces" on the repo to get a ready-to-use Strata environment with the server running automatically.
- [Operations](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/lifecycle/index.md): This page covers the operational disk-and-state story: where notebook data lives, how big it gets, how to back it up, how to move it, and how to clean up.
- [Observability](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/observability/index.md): Strata ships an opt-in observability stack, Jaeger for traces, Prometheus for metrics, Grafana for dashboards, wired up as a docker-compose file you can run al…
- [Privacy and sharing](https://bearingresearch.com/strata/0.12.0rc1/deployment/privacy/index.md): A personal server has one user, so it checks no identity: anyone who can reach it can list, open and execute every notebook under the storage root.
